summary.answer: Invokes AddBumperPaging on the second argument with first and third arguments. Sets _disableAutoScrolling=true on the supplied second argument. Sets _disableAutoScrolling=nil on the supplied second argument. If the item lacks getNextLocalLeftRight, delegates to AlignElementToListItem2D and returns. Otherwise reads next left/right and top/bottom of the item and its grandparent and applies the exact percentage/offset layout expressions to the target. Missing ancestors and zero sizes are not guarded. Calls getFirstSelectableItem(true) on the supplied receiver; there is no explicit return or separate focus invocation in this body. Requires an element with getDataSource and a nonnil returned datasource, then returns requestedCount <= datasource.getCount(element). Other paths return false. The getCount provider is not identified by its method spelling. Stores the supplied value unchanged in _keepSelectionPositionWhenPaging.
